images.subject: A far-future high-tech light fighter spacecraft: a small, sleek and agile single-seat fighter with a pointed nose, a bubble cockpit canopy, sharply swept-back wings carrying two slim laser cannons at their tips, and one engine at the rear, centred in the frame.
images.detail: It flies forward toward the right of the frame, nose first, and the engine nozzle at its rear end glows dim smoky orange-red behind it, on the left.
images.view: Close three-quarter view from slightly above, with the whole ship visible inside the frame and filling most of it.
images.site: It flies alone in the black of space in high orbit, above a lifeless grey rocky planet: the planet's curved horizon, with a thin bright rim of atmosphere, crosses the lower third of the frame from left to right, and its grey cratered surface, with one large round crater below the ship, fills the bottom of the frame, slightly out of focus. The sky above is pure black, with a soft warm golden haze of sunlight glowing along the right edge of the frame.
images.state: Battered pirate version of this ship: a patchwork hull of mismatched scavenged armour plates in different dull colours, rust streaks, crude welded seams and bolted-on extra plating and guns, dented and scorched, with a few crude dark red painted stripes; no text, no letters, no symbols.
